header.title: PRICING BY GROUP SIZE
header.sub: Same rates for the official session, the Custom camp and groups or clubs. The more of you there are, the lower the price per person. No discretionary discounts.

duo.label: Solo / Duo
duo.pitch: Rate applied to the Custom camp solo or as an adult pair, or to the official session for a single adult.

trio.label: Trio to 5
trio.pitch: Rate applied to the Custom camp as a team (3 or 4 friends) or to groups and clubs of 5 athletes.

club.label: Club / Group
club.pitch: Rate applied to organised clubs or groups of 6 to 10 adult athletes.

private.label: Private gym
private.pitch: Full privatisation of a session for an entire club. Custom quote.

family.title: PARENT PLUS CHILD PACKAGE
family.prose: You travel with your child aged 8 to 17. The package covers 1 parent plus 1 child. Each additional person, whether a second parent or an extra child, costs {additionalPerson} flat for the whole stay, regardless of duration.
family.base_sub: Fixed package depending on duration. The first child is included.
family.extra_sub: Single flat fee for the whole stay, identical regardless of duration.
family.example: Example: 1 parent plus 2 children = {base1} + {add1} = {ex1} (1 week). 2 parents plus 1 child for 2 weeks = {base2} + {add1} = {ex2}.

included.title: INCLUDED IN EVERY RATE

items.vol: Domestic flight Istanbul to Makhachkala (Wrestling) or Grozny (MMA)
items.encadrement: Coaching by the local coaches of the Caucasus

included.not_included: Not included: international flight to Istanbul (arranged by the applicant), travel insurance (mandatory), personal equipment, personal expenses. MKR surcharge for applications less than 30 days before departure (express processing).
